title: A facile and green one-step synthesis of Ag/reduced graphene oxide and its application in catalysts and SERS
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8764-8776
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00001G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanling Jia, Ke Zhang
Herein, we present a facile one-step approach for synthesizing Ag/reduced graphene oxide (Ag–rGO) through synchronous reduction and in situ coagulation of graphene oxide (GO) and silver nitrate (AgNO3) under a nitrogen atmosphere.
